# Mone Agency | Elite Model Management

Mone Agency is a premier South African modeling agency providing elite model management, scouting, and portfolio development. Based in Sandton Diamond District (Gauteng), Cape Town CBD (Western Cape), and Pietermaritzburg (KZN), we represent high-fashion talent for global and local campaigns.

## Core Services
- Model Management: Professional representation for high-fashion models.
- Scouting: Discovering new talent across South Africa's fashion hubs including Sandton, Cape Town, and Pietermaritzburg.
- Portfolio Development: Natural digital "polaroid" capture and professional portfolio building.

## Strategic Hubs
- Sandton (Diamond District): Elite business and fashion representation in Gauteng, serving Rosebank, Bryanston, and Centurion.
- Cape Town (V&A Waterfront Precinct): High-fashion scouting and campaign management in the Western Cape, serving Century City, Camps Bay, and Sea Point.
- Pietermaritzburg: Cultural and regional talent development in KZN, serving the Midlands and Howick.

## Application Requirements
Aspiring models can apply directly via our portal at https://evansxm.github.io/mone-agency/#apply
- Required Data: Height (cm), Age, Bust/Waist/Hips measurements, Shoe Size, Hair/Eye colour, Instagram handle, Email address.
- Digitals: Max 10 natural photos, under 2MB each. No heavy makeup or professional retouching.
